evidence.title: Pasqal partners with Eleven Ventures to expand its quantum computing services in Saudi Arabia

summary: French quantum computing startup Pasqal has entered a partnership with Saudi-backed Eleven Ventures to extend its quantum computing offerings in the Kingdom. The collaboration aims to accelerate the adoption of quantum technologies across Saudi Arabia’s research and industry sectors.
title: Pasqal teams up with Eleven Ventures to broaden quantum computing services in Saudi Arabia
